text: The paper reports that the best participant-flow approach (perplexity classifier plus few-shot prompt from demonstrations) was also best on a Qasper sample, scoring 69% accuracy versus 38% for the top-1 select-then-generate baseline and 55% for perplexity selection without demonstrations. The authors take this as evidence the decomposition is somewhat robust to domain transfer.
title: Decomposition transfers to Qasper: 38% to 69% accuracy
